seo.seo_title: Website pricing, from SEK 195/month | Norden Media UF
seo.seo_description: Three packages with a fixed start-up cost and a fixed monthly fee for website, email, visibility and hosting. You only pay once you are happy.

page_header.t4: Professionally built websites at a fixed price. We handle hosting, security and the changes included in your package.

paket.t6: A professional, high-quality website with what your business needs to be found and receive customers.
paket.t15: Your own domain and one email address
paket.t17: The basics for being found on Google
paket.t22: For businesses that want to reach further, with better visibility on Google, booking or quote forms and ongoing improvements.
paket.t32: Google Business Profile and visibility in AI answers
paket.t38: The complete solution, with a customer system, automation and personal support.
paket.t46: You only pay when you are happy.
paket.t54: As a UF student company we are not VAT registered, so no VAT is added to the prices. The start-up cost is paid once and is only invoiced after you have approved the finished website. The monthly fee starts when the website goes live. Changes beyond what is included cost SEK 450 per hour.

jamforelse.t88: The basics for being found on Google

after_the_uf_year.t92: A UF student company runs for one school year, but working with us does not have to end there. Our plan is to continue the business as a limited company, with the same people and the same service, for every client who wants to stay.
after_the_uf_year.t93: The website and all its content belong to you.
after_the_uf_year.t94: If you would rather run it yourselves, we show you how everything works and hand over all the material. If you need changes later on, we are still here to help at an hourly rate.

live_streaming.t96: Quoted per event. You get a fixed price before we start.
